Maya Singh: quick heads-up - PTQ canary for bridge-lite3 stopped parsing ~9% of funcall outputs on sample=500, pattern looks like stray backslashes and dangling commas.
Ravi Patel: only PTQ? did we run fp32 baseline?
Maya Singh: fp32 baseline ~0.4% failures. so quant-specific.
Ravi Patel: any repro saved?
Maya Singh: yes s3://canaries/ptq-backslash/repro-5333.jsonl with seeds.
Maya Singh: quick raw example: ```{"tool":"get_user","args":{"id":"u123"},}``` (trailing comma) and `{"note":"Path: C:\Temp\"}` coming out as single backslash causing unclosed string.
Ravi Patel: suggests tokenization at boundary. try disabling kv-prefetch in a cohort to see if prefix concat is the culprit.
Maya Singh: launching two cohorts (kvcache on/off) + sanitize+retry rescue pipeline to measure recovery. will post numbers later.
ops-bot: canary started: ptq-backslash-5333 | model=bridge-lite3-ptq | samples=1200
Ravi Patel: thanks — if kvcache correlates, hold PTQ rollout until we have a mitigation.
Maya Singh: agreed, will update.
